name: Leeds School of Arts: FASHION X GAMES
author: mariellereuser
description: FASHION X GAMES is a collaboration between BA Games Art and BA Fashion at Leeds Beckett University. Explore an interactive, colourful world built by BA Games Art Lecturer Marielle Reuser and BA Animation and Visual Effects student Talia Koyi. Now the Pandemic has cancelled most live fashion shows, players are invited to view the final collections of BA Fashion students from the comfort of their own home. Fashion design by Yaku Stapleton, Hannah Taylor, Amy Wells and Dita Krona in Marvelous Designer.
